models_evaluated: hybrid system: symbolic component with medical knowledge graphs plus ensemble of three LLMs (unnamed) with critical review mechanism

links.outcome: Generation of details not present in source reports during automated ICD-9-CM coding
links.effect: Authors report a tendency to generate details not present in reports; diagnosis accuracy 70.53%, procedure accuracy 78.28% against expert panel gold standard.
links.quote: Key challenges include limited ICD-9-CM codes, particularly for rare diseases, overreliance on nonspecific residual codes, and tendency to generate details not present in reports.

unlisted_practices: Hybrid architecture combining symbolic knowledge graphs with an LLM ensemble and critical review mechanism for coding
Adopting ICD-10/ICD-11 and multi-ontology approach for interoperability (FAIR)
Implementing reliability metrics for automated coding output

screen.reason: The study evaluates an ensemble LLM and knowledge graph architecture on synthetic clinical records for automated ICD-9 coding for rare disease registries, evaluated against multidisciplinary expert double-coding.
